CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  March 8, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

ITEMS 1-3:
MINUTES: January 11, 2022
MINUTES: January 25, 2022
MINUTES: February 8, 2022

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 4:
APPLICANT: 2576 Loma Vista Drive

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for continuance to allow for a redesign.

The designer was present.

  1
 Tsai stated that he agreed with the staff comments regarding the redesign of the front elevation.

Daninger stated that the roofline could be simplified and questioned the stone wainscot not
extending to the ground. He also agreed with the staff comments regarding a redesign.

Hernandez questioned the style that was intended. The applicant stated that he was designing
towards a Ranch style. Hernandez stated that the elements and materials used did not resonate with
a Ranch style and also agreed with staff recommendations.

Udani stated that the design was very busy and the style did not reflect a Ranch style.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 5:
APPLICANT: 1000 South 5th Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the entry be
recessed.

The designer was present and gave a brief presentation.

Tsai stated that the massing had improved. He questioned the material used for the window trim
and the detail of the guardrail used for the two balconies. He stated that the front balcony was out
of place and did not need to be there. He also agreed with staff recommendation regarding the
entry recess and stated concern for weather protection.

The applicant stated that the window trim shown is an integral part of the window product. He
also clarified that the metal railings don’t intersect any roof slopes and sit in front of the roofline.
The applicant stated that there was enough contrast to not have to recess the entry.

Daninger questioned how the balconies will be drained. The applicant stated that they will have a
floor drain that will exit through the ceiling. Daninger also agreed with the recess of the entry.

Hernandez stated that the design represents a Ranch style home. She stated that the front balcony
was not necessary. She commented on the proportion of the entry porch and stated that it could be
wider, possibly covering the two adjacent windows. She also agreed with the recess of the entry to
address the flat facade rather than weather concerns.

  2
 Udani stated that the overall design has improved. He stated that in addition to the porch feeling
small, the balcony was not proportional to the second floor elevation. Udani also agreed with the
board and staff recommendation regarding the entry recess.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The
  applicant shall work with staff on refining the front elevation, including recessing the entry
  and revising proportions; 2. The color of the balcony railings shall be revised to be more
  compatible with the color palette; and 3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved
  by DRB staff.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 6:
APPLICANT: 1515 South 8th Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the front feature
window be retained.

The designer was present.

Daninger, Tsai and Hernandez stated that they had no issues with the design and agreed with staff
comments to retain the existing feature window.

Udani asked for clarification regarding the patio covering. The applicant stated that it was existing
and would not be touched.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The front
  feature window shall be retained; and 2. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved
  by DRB staff prior to building plan check.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 7:

  3
 APPLICANT: 2928 Pyrenees Drive

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant was not present.

Hernandez, Daninger and Udani all stated that they had no issues with the proposal.

Tsai agreed with the board members but questioned the replacement of the garage door.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant work
  with staff on the design details of the garage door.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 8:
APPLICANT: 2015 Chestnut Street

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. The
applicant shall submit a color specification for all new paint finishes; 2. The mechanical screening
should be revised to match and align with the existing screen; and 3. All revised drawings shall be
reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to building plan check.

The designer was present.

The designer stated that the proposed blue color will match the existing blue.

Tsai, Hernandez, Daninger and Udani stated they had no issues with the proposed design and
agreed with staff recommendations.

Hernandez clarified that the scope of work is only for Building 1. The applicant confirmed and
stated that the other buildings may be altered in the future.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The
  applicant shall submit color specifications for all new paint finishes; 2. The mechanical
  screening should be revised to match and align with the existing screen; 3. The
  specification for the new metal canopies shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff; and

  4
   4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to building plan
  check.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:45pm
 •  Seconded by Michael Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 22nd day of March, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_____________________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
